visual_brief: 茹鲁阿河是亚马孙西部极度蜿蜒的褐色河流，在阿克里州克鲁塞罗－杜苏尔、亚马孙州卡拉瓦里一带穿行于连绵雨林，航拍可见密集的 U 形河曲与牛轭湖。易混：马代拉河、马瑙斯段亚马孙干流。
notes: 无合格可商用照片，建议出图。试过：Flickr CC（rio Juruá / Jurua / Juruá / Jurua river / rio Jurua Acre / Juruá Amazonas / Cruzeiro do Sul / Cruzeiro do Sul Acre / Eirunepé / Carauari / Marechal Thaumaturgo / tag riojurua），只有巴西海军一张航拍 1170×700（裁后高 700，不足）和 ESA 卫星图（非照片）；Openverse 接口 504；Pexels/Unsplash 本环境无法访问；WebSearch 只找到 Getty 付费图与 ESA 卫星图。理想画面描述：Aerial drone photograph of the Juruá River in the western Brazilian Amazon near Cruzeiro do Sul, Acre: a muddy café-au-lait river looping in tight serpentine meanders and oxbow lakes through unbroken dense green rainforest, bright midday sun with scattered cumulus clouds, high oblique angle so several bends fill the frame and the river is the clear subject; a small wooden riverboat for scale. Avoid: the wide straight Amazon at Manaus, black-water rivers, sunset silhouettes, haze, maps or satellite false colour.
